item.description: In the winter here, it’s not unusual to see a car on the side of I-35. item.title: I Am Dyeing My Hair Brown
item.description: I have an announcement: I am dyeing my hair brown—deep, thick, chocolatey brown. I do this to signal I am entering a period of mental and emotional darkness. I am embracing the winter. I am welcoming in the gloom.
